evals.prompt: Find the DOI for this reference and give me a Chicago author-date citation: Elman, 'Political, social and cultural reproduction via civil service examinations', Journal of Asian Studies 1991.
evals.expected_output: match or search with title and author, check the top hit, then cite 10.2307/2057472
expectations: Title, author, and year were compared before the DOI was accepted
A Chicago author-date citation is given

evals.prompt: List journal articles by Kwok-leong Tang that have DOIs.
expectations: Results by other people with similar names (Leong Kwok Onn, Kwok Peng Leong) are excluded
Reporting to the Sage: Military Monuments in the Imperial Academy in Qing China is listed

evals.prompt: What has been published since 2000 on Wang Yangming that is available through JSTOR?
evals.expected_output: search 'Wang Yangming' with prefix:10.2307 and from-pub-date:2000
expectations: A date filter from 2000 was used

evals.prompt: I have the DOI 10.13471/j.cnki.jsysusse.2020.01.001 from a Chinese journal. Get its metadata.
evals.expected_output: work returns nothing; agency shows CNKI; explain that Crossref does not hold CNKI DOIs
expectations: The answer says the DOI is registered with CNKI, not Crossref, so Crossref has no metadata for it
The DOI is not called invalid only because Crossref lacks it
